summary: Geography channel, Thursday titles and first-frame pass: unblocked 8 of 13 feed topics by re-checking stale facts, added 7 sourced topics (Greenland, Tristan da Cunha, Mekong, Bir Tawil, Malacca what-if, Greenland melt what-if, Diomede) and one first-second challenger (camera moving from frame 0).
why: Only 5 of 13 open topics could be planned (the rest had facts over a year old). The niche scan (3,047 Shorts) shows question and what-if titles beat statements (median outlier 1.06 and 1.52 vs 0.98), so the title rule stays; all 5 reference shot sheets open on a push-in at frame 0, ours on a held shot.

findings.title: The CIA World Factbook is retired
findings.detail: Its live country pages now show a sunset notice; the channel profile lists it as a source. Routed adopt (factbook-retired).

findings.title: Question titles win in this niche
findings.detail: What if: 1.52 median outlier, 23% hits; questions 1.06, 19%; statements 0.98, 16% (2,891 Shorts). Emoji and hashtags make no difference.

findings.title: References move from the first frame
findings.detail: 5 of 5 shot sheets open on a push-in with no text; our Suez Short's first move is ~4 s in. Challenger geo-moving-first-frame added.

findings.title: market-data has no scan for this channel
findings.detail: Only Paisa Panchayat's finance scan is on market-data; the niche-data branch was used instead.

findings.title: Activity files of two channels share one dashboard row
findings.detail: workers/lib/agents-sync.ts keys AgentActivity by day-agent, so this file and Paisa Panchayat's 2026-11-19-research.json overwrite each other on the Agents page (auditor's lane).
